Translucent shapes drift continuously across the dark background, occasionally leaving lingering luminous trails. These trails interact with the flow, causing flares and dissipating rings of light. The structural glowing wakes that result from these interactions ripple and brighten momentarily, before slowly dissipating back into the deep cosmic background. The scene moves continuously without requiring any user input.

Particles drift slowly across the dark canvas, leaving luminous trails that interact with each other through a subtle flow field system.
